scope: Review predicates over explicitly bounded Boolean abstractions. These are not replacements for atomic runtime guards or exhaustive physical models.

models.scope: Design review of a new authenticated upload entering the durable queue; not container admission or media decodability.
models.omitted_detail: Aggregate request/storage predicates must expand to actual route, identity, byte, parameter and transactional checks; no liveness guarantee.

models.scope: Public API delivery review, specifically public_api_ready, not public_ready or whole-system ready.
models.omitted_detail: Freshness includes supervisor validity and current intent/probe epoch. Must be rechecked at the actual use boundary.

models.scope: Manager is eligible to issue a bounded execute offer, not proof it was accepted or that GPU inference started.
models.omitted_detail: Container request validation and resource admission occur after the offer; dispatch policy includes drain and unknown-attempt reconciliation.

models.scope: Design review of a new attempt, excluding the separate idempotent replay/reconciliation branch; not a GPU-start predicate.
models.omitted_detail: Model usability includes ready, alive and its validated precision policy; request identity includes schema/instance/job/attempt consistency. Estimates are not hard physical caps. Existing-attempt replay must be modeled separately.

models.scope: Design predicate for one current attempt at the GPU transition. Atomic grants are receipts, not free-capacity observations.
models.assumption_basis: Declared lifecycle implications of this abstraction; source review supports their intent, but this logical model does not independently prove all runtime trajectories.
models.omitted_detail: Acceptance, precision validation, resource pressure, revocation and identity are expanded by the owning runtime. Conditions imply permission in this model, not eventual success.

models.scope: Historical contract review of eligibility to commit a successful artifact; committing and later download remain separate effects.
models.omitted_detail: Ownership, freshness, cancellation policy and transactional state transition are aggregate obligations; a Boolean file-exists snapshot cannot prevent concurrent mutation. Client download is not a prerequisite for server commit.

models.scope: Historical review of the selected manager/model lifetime; no assertion about a presently running service.
models.omitted_detail: Each observation has a defined evidence scope; process exit alone is insufficient for platform release.

models.scope: Synthetic policy example for exhaustive inclusion-minimal search; not an implemented H3 acceptance rule.
models.omitted_detail: Abstract evidence routes only. Both the one-condition and two-condition sets must be retained; shortest is not the only minimal set.
